name: SecretScan
shortDescription: Scoped scanner for candidate secrets in source code, with redacted reports and remediation guidance.
features: 8 built-in candidate rules (cloud keys, tokens, PEM keys, JWTs, password assignments, DB URLs)
Explicit scan scope with skip rules (venv, node_modules, binaries)
Reports redact values (test-enforced) and carry remediation guidance
Findings framed as candidates, never confirmed credentials
knownLimitations: Pattern matching cannot confirm a credential is live
Configurable rules are file-based (no plugin system yet)
